This article describes how to pin Firefox to the taskbar on Windows for easy access. To learn how to set Firefox as your default browser, see [[Make Firefox your default browser on Windows]].

__TOC__

=Pin Firefox from the taskbar=
#Open Firefox on your computer. The Firefox icon will appear in the taskbar.  
#Right-click on the icon and select {menu Pin to taskbar}.
#;[[Image:pin firefox to task bar]]

=Pin Firefox from the start menu=
==Windows 10==
#Click the Windows menu button in the taskbar.
#Find the Firefox browser. Right-click on it and select {menu Pin to taskbar}.

==Windows 11==
#Click the Windows menu button in the taskbar.
#Click the {button ALL} button at the top right side of the apps panel.
#;[[Image:ALL start menu]]
#Hover over the Firefox browser and right-click on it and select {menu Pin to taskbar}.
Alternatively, you can drag the Firefox icon directly from your desktop onto the taskbar.

=Unpin Firefox from the taskbar=
# Right-click the Firefox icon in the taskbar.
# Select {menu Unpin from taskbar}.
#;[[Image:Unpin from taskbar]]

=Unpin Firefox from the start menu=
#Click the Windows menu button in the taskbar.
#;[[Image:start]]
#Hover over the Firefox browser and right-click it.
#Select {menu Unpin from Start}.
#;[[Image:Unpin from start]]
